bio.text: Nick LaLota represents New York's 1st Congressional District and was first sworn into office in January 2023.
He graduated from the U.S. Naval Academy and served in the Navy, reaching the rank of Lieutenant, including as a Surface Warfare Officer.
He was appointed to the Amityville Board of Trustees in 2013 and later served as Commissioner of the Suffolk County Board of Elections and as Chief of Staff to the Suffolk County Legislature.
